note: Work here means economic activity, including paid work and the production of goods for own use. Household chores (such as cooking, cleaning, and childcare) are not included.
title: Share of children in child labor
subtitle: Percentage of children aged 5–17 in child labor. What counts as child labor depends on the child’s age, hours worked, and type of work.
